The provided code has a fundamental flaw: the `count_words` function expects an iterable of file paths, but the `__main__` block passes a string `'*.txt'`, which will cause the program to attempt to open a file literally named `*.txt` rather than expanding the glob pattern. Additionally, the solution does not actually read all text files under a directory—it lacks any directory traversal or globbing logic (e.g., using `glob.glob` or `os.walk`). The word splitting is also simplistic, not handling punctuation or case normalization. While the core counting logic using `collections.Counter` is correct, the program as a whole does not satisfy the user's request.

Rating: [[3]]
